title: Claiming Your Professional Identity
text: At the end of the fall semester you presented on the past, present, and future of your professional identity and career goals. In this session, we’ll revisit those narratives and think about how they translate into key talking points and identifiers as you pursue professional employment or additional education.

title: Defining Your Capstone
text:

title: Defining Your Capstone
text:
Before we Meet
Using the databases listed below in the Resources section, identify a MUP capstone from a prior year that is related to your own capstone to review. Complete a critical review of the capstone, and come to class prepared to deliver a 5-minute presentation that summarizes the following:

The main goals and objectives of the capstone.
The target audience for the capstone.
The approach taken.
Key findings.
Your critical assessment of the capstone - what was particularly effective? What would you have done differently?
